title: Error Budget Stewardship: Initiative Pulse & Automated Rollout Throttle
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: Define and implement an initiative-level 'pulse' that automatically converts SLI deviations and remaining error budget into rollout throttle decisions for ongoing reliability initiatives. The feature will give PMs automated rollback and hold gates tied to a shared SLO ledger, reducing manual coordination across teams during degradation windows.
acceptance_criteria: Pulse score computed per initiative every 5 minutes using weighted SLIs (latency P50/P95, infra errors, tail-CPU) and remaining error budget
Automated Rollout Throttle (ART) can pause, reduce, or resume percentage rollouts via the Console rollout API based on pulse thresholds
Initiative ledger shows historical pulse values, actions taken, and a linkable timeline for postmortems
Cross-team safety policy enforces a hard stop if shared SLOs drop below configured tranche
Telemetry: dashboard card with pulse time-series and rollout action histogram; alerts when ART takes automated action
comments: 2025-02-18 - Ava Martinez: Kickoff - scoped proposal and goals. Motivation: PMs spend ~2-6h/day coordinating manual rollbacks during SLO blips. Want to automate simple decisions while keeping humans in the loop for complex incidents. Attached PRD draft in Drive.

2025-02-20 - Jordan Lee: Engineering sync - ENG concerns about false positives from short-lived latency spikes. Proposed mitigation: require 3 consecutive 5-min pulse breaches before ART reduces rollout by step. Also suggested a 'graceback' period to slowly ramp back up if metrics recover.

2025-02-25 - Priya Gupta (SRE): Reviewed safety thresholds. Recommended weighting error budget burn higher than latency for automated hard-stop decisions. Added dependency on distributed tracing correlation to avoid noisy signals from client-side issues.

2025-02-27 - Design review (Maya Chen): UX for initiative ledger reviewed. Need a compact timeline view with action affordances (acknowledge, override, annotate). Design will hand off component specs next week. Consider accessibility for color-blind users when showing pulse severity.

2025-02-28 - Jordan Lee: Implementation plan v1 - backend pulse service + Console integration. Pulse service consumes existing SLI stream, computes per-initiative score, emits events to rollout-controller. Created initial RFC: github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pulse-art (WIP).

2025-03-01 - Ava Martinez: Product review - asked PMs from two product teams to trial config knobs in a sandbox: sensitivity, hard-stop threshold, rollback window. Need to capture feedback about acceptable aggressiveness and rollback owner escalation.

2025-03-02 - Jordan Lee: Blocker identified - rollout-controller needs permissioning update for ART to act on dedicated deployment rollouts (security review). Opened ENG-29812 to add RBAC checks; ART will be read-only until resolved.
